definition: A configuration setting that limits the maximum number of tokens a language model will generate in a single response.
details: The max tokens parameter is a basic but important control for managing response length, latency, and cost in applications built on top of language model APIs.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. In plain words: A configuration setting that limits the maximum number of tokens a language model will generate in a single response. Here is how it actually plays out: The max tokens parameter is a basic but important control for managing response length, latency, and cost in applications built on top of language model APIs. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Max Tokens Parameter.
